_comment: Unguarded server actions: NONE. This list is EMPTY as of 2026-09-03 and must stay empty - a new entry means a 'use server' export shipped without an authorization check, and the gate fails rather than recording it. History: 30 entries on 2026-08-31, of which 6 were FALSE POSITIVES (settings/team/actions.ts defines its own requireAdmin(); the gate matched only imported guard names until the local-guard detector was ported from nurock-devmgmt), 2 moved to NO_GUARD_NEEDED in the gate script (owner-scoped notification writes, authorized by ownership rather than by role), and 22 were guarded. Every 'use server' export is a public POST endpoint that does NOT pass through the (app) route gate - see the header of scripts/server-action-guard-check.mjs.
